messages:
maya: Heads-up — procurement pinged me about ChargeScout and InvoiceLens for automating invoice reconciliation. They sent a pricing sheet but I'm unclear on the unit metric. anyone familiar?
jordana: We ran a light POC with ChargeScout last quarter. Short notes: quick ingest, mapping UI is decent, but pricing was weird — per-invoice + per-connector.
kevin: @maya can you share the vendor email? curious about minimum commits and how they count credits for attachments (pdfs).
maya: pasted relevant part from the vendor: 
```
ChargeScout pricing: $0.15 per invoice processed + $0.02 per attachment page, enterprise plan includes SSO and data retention negotiable.
POC discount: 3 months free, then standard pricing. Min annual commit: $30k.
```
kevin: ok that helps. Does that $0.15 cover line-item extraction + GL mapping?
jordana: In our trial it covered OCR + basic line-item extraction. GL mapping and custom rules were billed as professional services (we paid ~$6k for rules work).
maya: Procurement asked for: 1) sample mapping for our current GCP export format 2) how ChargeScout handles unmatched line items (audit trail required) 3) renewal negotiation levers (commits, seats, retention) 4) data residency and KMS support.
pete: For negotiation leverage i'd push for: longer POC with staged pricing, lower per-invoice at scale (e.g., < $0.06 past 100k/mo), and remove per-page charge for compressed PDFs.
finance-ops: Important: vendor must support programmatic access to reconciliation results (we need a webhook + S3 dump) and an audit log we can forward to Splunk. Also need SLA on processing latency (we want <4h batch SLA).
maya: Great. I drafted questions for vendor — can y'all sanity-check before I send: 
1) Can you process our sample GCP CSV/GCS export? Any schema gaps?
2) How do you price multi-currency invoices and FX adjustments?
3) Do you offer volume tiers that reduce per-invoice cost at 50k/100k/250k monthly buckets?
4) Is SSO (SAML + SCIM) included in enterprise pricing or extra?
5) Can rules/GL mappings be exported as code or YAML?
6) What are typical onboarding effort hours and cost?
7) What termination/rollback support if mapping regressions occur?
8) Will you sign our data processing addendum + KMS controls?

kevin: add: 9) sample SLA for processing latency and error rate targets. and 10) do you allow a 30-day out clause for the first contract year if accuracy < X on our benchmark prompts.
jordana: Also ask for a sample invoice of how they'd break down charges for our projected volume (we gave them ~1.2M invoices/yr in the RFP).
procurement-bot: Reminder: attach the RFP doc when you reply. Use template: /procure/reply-template-v2.
maya: Sending email now — will paste thread here. If vendor proposes a per-seat admin fee that's a red flag; we prefer usage-based or a single enterprise seat included.
pete: If they push PS for every connector integration, ask for fixed-fee scoping or commit hours included in the onboarding.
finance-ops: One more: ask about invoice-level vs line-item level pricing. We reconcile at line item level; if they charge per invoice but miss line-level figures it's a showstopper.
maya: Got it. I'll send and tag y'all on the reply. Thanks for the quick takes :rocket:
